variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: A unified AI platform is a set of shared contracts and managed capabilities that teams use to build, evaluate, release, observe, and retire ML systems. It connects data, compute, model artifacts, policy evidence, runtime operations, and accountable owners without forcing every workload into one implementation.
variants.prompt: Match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Developer plane
pairs.detail: Templates, APIs, SDKs, and a portal turn a project request into reviewable configuration instead of hidden automation.
pairs.explanation: Templates, APIs, SDKs, and a portal turn a project request into reviewable configuration instead of hidden automation.

pairs.label: Control plane
pairs.detail: Controllers validate identity, quotas, lineage, evaluation, release policy, environment compatibility, and desired state.
pairs.explanation: Controllers validate identity, quotas, lineage, evaluation, release policy, environment compatibility, and desired state.

pairs.label: Data and execution plane
pairs.detail: Pipelines, feature systems, training jobs, registries, serving runtimes, and accelerators execute under declared resource and access limits.
pairs.explanation: Pipelines, feature systems, training jobs, registries, serving runtimes, and accelerators execute under declared resource and access limits.

pairs.label: Evidence plane
pairs.detail: Metrics, traces, logs, model outcomes, cost, approvals, incidents, and retirements remain linked to project and artifact identity.
pairs.explanation: Metrics, traces, logs, model outcomes, cost, approvals, incidents, and retirements remain linked to project and artifact identity.

pairs.label: Register the project
pairs.detail: Declare the service owner, workload identities, data class, environments, budgets, dependencies, reviewers, and supported workload type.
pairs.explanation: Declare the service owner, workload identities, data class, environments, budgets, dependencies, reviewers, and supported workload type.

pairs.label: Build reproducibly
pairs.detail: Run versioned code against registered data and feature contracts.
pairs.explanation: Run versioned code against registered data and feature contracts. Capture the environment, parameters, logs, outputs, and lineage under one run identity.

pairs.label: Promote evidence
pairs.detail: Bind the model, preprocessing, prompt or policy, runtime contract, evaluation results, signatures, and compatibility metadata to a content-addressed bundle.
pairs.explanation: Bind the model, preprocessing, prompt or policy, runtime contract, evaluation results, signatures, and compatibility metadata to a content-addressed bundle.

pairs.label: Release and operate
pairs.detail: Apply shadow or canary policy, observe system and model outcomes, attribute cost, preserve rollback, and retire artifacts through an auditable controller.
pairs.explanation: Apply shadow or canary policy, observe system and model outcomes, attribute cost, preserve rollback, and retire artifacts through an auditable controller.

variants.prompt: What does “unified” mean in a healthy AI platform?
options: Consistent identity, metadata, interfaces, evidence, and operations across supported workflows
One model framework and one serving runtime for every workload
A single production cluster with no tenant boundaries
A developer portal that owns every application outcome
variants.explanation: The platform unifies durable contracts. It can support several implementations when they preserve those contracts.
